notes: Authority matrix · founder-authorised design 2026-09-12. DESIGN ONLY. Every component has EXACTLY ONE authority scope · no silent inheritance. Any attempt to widen a component's authority requires founder ADR.

components.conditional_on: authorised Engineering Work Order · founder-scope authorisation for production mutation
may: produce implementations against a Work Order
modify code within Work Order scope
may_not: determine whether its implementation is superior
modify code outside the Work Order scope

components.conditional_on: receipt of NEX1 candidate + evidence bundle · NEVER converts to execution
may: propose alternatives with cited reasons · OPTIONAL
may_not: claim evidence the Evidence Engine did not produce

components.conditional_on: evidence bundle references · advisory until founder authorisation
may: produce structured verdict from 6 verdict types
may_not: invent verdicts beyond the 6 authorised types
self-promote to binding without founder authorisation

components.conditional_on: founder-whitelisted sources only · candidate queue only
may: register candidate practices with sourced references
escalate to NEX2 challenge + NEX3 arbitration
may_not: promote candidates to standards without founder ADR
ingest raw internet content without deterministic filtering

may: invoke authorised measurement tools (compiler · type-checker · tests · analyser · etc.)
flag STALE evidence when source_hashes change
may_not: generate measurements without tool + tool_version + reproducibility_information
inherit execution · review · arbitration · promotion authority

may: expose read APIs for NEX1 consumption
amend criteria or weights via ADR
widen or narrow authority scopes via ADR
may_not: be silently overridden by any subsystem
delegate constitutional authority to any NEX component

invariants: no component silently inherits another component's authority
widening any authority scope requires founder-authored ADR
advisory ≠ authoritative · advisory verdicts do not act
measurement ≠ decision · Evidence Engine measures · never decides
review ≠ execution · NEX2 reviews · never merges
arbitration ≠ authorisation · NEX3 arbitrates · founder authorises
research ≠ promotion · LAB researches · founder promotes
